note: The disposable accounts the local signed-in exercise creates in its LOCAL deck copy. Passwords are generated per run (random, 18 bytes, base64url) and written to <run dir>/credentials.json with mode 0600; they are never printed, logged, or stored here.

accounts.name: Harness Admin
accounts.how_created: Person card (type `user`) + `+account` junction + `+email`, `+salt`, `+password`, `+status` fields; password hashed by the engine's own hashPassword (src/card/auth/password-hash.ts); role granted by a card_references row from the deck's existing `Administrator+*members` list to the holder card.

accounts.name: Harness Member
accounts.role: none (signed in only, no role card)
accounts.how_created: Same row shape, with no role membership, so it is an ordinary signed-in account.

where.deck: <run dir>/deck.sqlite3 — a local copy of Brandon's deck rebuilt on the engine schema (tools/edge-signed-in-exercise/lib/build-local-deck.mjs). Never the Bunny database.
where.bunny: The harness reads the live script's environment variables read-only (GET https://api.bunny.net/compute/script/96867) and never writes to Bunny. Only 127.0.0.1/localhost is driven; the live site is never touched.
